column1: # Compilation units other than the main build. Read by scripts/pipeline.ps1 (decompiler),
# A type token (0x02......) gives the whole top-level type, nested types included, to a unit:
#   debugplus   same compiler and source tree, /debug+ next to /optimize+ (build/osu.csproj)
#   csc40       the files of the type alone, compiled by the C# compiler of the .NET Framework 4.x
# A method token (0x06......) is for the unit 'il' only: the method is written in IL.

column3: EmbeddedAssemblyLoader, the obfuscator's resolver of embedded assemblies: locals read once keep their slot ('stloc; ldloc; ret'), the lock is the one of a compiler without Monitor.Enter(object, ref bool), the iterator is Roslyn's
ResourceAssemblyResolver, the obfuscator's resource resolver, initialized by the same module initializer: smethod_3 keeps three locals read once
MergedAssemblyReferences, list of the assembly references the obfuscator saw: smethod_0 keeps its locals read once
Obfuscator.StringDecryptor: IsCalledThroughOwnAssembly keeps its locals read once

AssemblyBoundKey, runtime checks of the obfuscator: 'ldc.i4.0; conv.i8; bne.un' for 'x == 0L' and 'ldlen; conv.i4; brtrue' are the compiler from before Roslyn. csc 2.0, 3.5 and 4.x give the same 24 methods
OptimizedEnumerable, the obfuscator's own Any / FirstOrDefault: 'ldlen; conv.i4; brtrue' and 'ceq; ldc.i4.0; ceq', the same compiler
<Module>::.cctor, the obfuscator's module initializer (it starts the two resolvers): C# 7.3 has no module initializer
VirtualMachine.RunInstructionLoop: catches System.Object in a local of that type. C# only names what it catches as an Exception
VirtualMachine.ThrowObject: throws a System.Object. C# only throws an Exception ('castclass' otherwise)

OptimizedEnumerable.HasItems: 'get_Count; conv.i4; ldc.i4.0; ceq; ldc.i4.0; ceq', the body of smethod_3 with 'ldlen' turned into a call of List.Count. No compiler converts an int to int: six casts tried with csc 4.x

KeySequences/MixedSequenceIterator MoveNext: an iterator of the compiler over the obfuscator's own copies of IEnumerator (IEnumeratorClone) and IDisposable, with the 'fault' handler of an iterator. C# writes neither
KeySequences/MixedSequenceIterator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator: 'call' of the explicit implementation of the generic GetEnumerator, as the compiler writes in an iterator class

StringDecryptor.DecryptCore: 'call' of StringBuilder.Append on a local, methods pasted with their arguments in locals, loops over the copied interfaces: assembled by the obfuscator for this binary, not the output of a compiler
